limits: Splices sequences as given; no thermodynamic check of the result.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Concatenates supplied index sequences with adapter arms or a primer (optionally reverse-complemented); computes no quantity.
bio.jane/contract.question: What oligos does a synthesizer make for these indexes on these adapter arms or primer?

description: Turn index sequences into the oligos a synthesiser makes: each index spliced between 5'/3' adapter arms, or onto a PCR primer in either orientation with an optional spacer. Audited for the problems that only exist once tag and oligo are concatenated and that no check of the index alone can see — a homopolymer run across the junction, a 5' tetramer recurring as its reverse complement, and an oligo over the synthesis length guideline.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

adapter_3.description: 3' arm the index is spliced before — the TruSeq read-1 primer, and the panel's own default.

adapter_5.description: 5' arm the index is spliced after — the Illumina P5, and the panel's own default.

format.description: adapter arms around the index, or a tagged PCR primer. Values: adapter (5'/3' adapter arms), primer (Tagged PCR primer).

primer.description: the PCR primer the tag is appended to — required when `format` is `primer`.

reverse_complement_tag.description: use each tag as its reverse complement, in an adapter or on a primer, as the instrument requires for some read orientations. Advanced.

spacer.description: bases between the tag and the primer. Heterogeneity/phasing spacers are routine on a low-diversity library. Advanced.

name: assemble_index_oligos

longest.description: the longest assembled oligo, in bases — the number a synthesis quote turns on

oligos.description: each assembled oligo with its name, sequence and length

warnings.description: junction problems that only exist once tag and oligo are joined: a run across the junction, a self-complementary 5' tetramer, an oligo over the synthesis guideline
